p-drakes-9524756414677.d:
A true staple of the modern wardrobe, the single-breasted jacket forms the foundation of a considered collection. Its clean lines and 3-roll-2 button stance create a sharp, versatile silhouette, perfectly balanced for everyday ease.
Cut in the Drake’s signature silhouette, it features a natural shoulder, subtle waist shaping, and a light construction that allows the jacket to move gracefully with the wearer.
Expertly tailored and fully canvassed with a hand-shaped chest, the jacket drapes naturally over the body, offering both shape and comfort. Hand-attached collars and sleeves provide a flexibility unmatched by machine construction, allowing the jacket to adapt seamlessly to the wearer, while a buggy lining ensures fluidity across the back and shoulders, and traditional lapels, with a wider profile and richer belly, reflect our time-honed house style.
Cut from a 10oz twill woven in Prato by a family-run mill with more than 70 years of textile expertise, balancing the warmth and resilience of virgin wool with the dry, tactile character that comes from the cotton woven through it.

p-drakes-9236867776725.d:
Crafted from a piece-dyed 5.4oz cotton–linen blend woven in Japan, this iteration introduces a first for the Games range: a considered double-layer construction that brings added substance, resilience, and sense of structure to an otherwise easy-wearing piece, enhancing its durability while retaining a soft, lived-in feel.
Utility remains central to its design. Reinforced elbow patches and a total of five external pockets, including a distinctive double chest pocket and our signature peeking ticket pocket, are complemented by two internal compartments. Removable pin buttons, secured through embroidered eyelets, nod to traditional workwear uniforms, where detachable hardware was designed to simplify laundering.
An effortless layer with a little more behind it, built to be worn often and worn well.
